responsibility: Implements GCC’s middle-end and RTL-level exception-handling machinery for a function. It manages EH region trees, landing pads, throw-statement mappings, and personality requirements; supports lowering-time and expansion-time bookkeeping for cleanup, catch, filter, and must-not-throw regions; verifies and dumps EH structures; and emits the exception tables and region-range metadata that let the runtime and generated code route thrown exceptions to the correct handlers or cleanup actions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the operational exception-handling logic over those EH structures, such as personality selection, EH tree dumping/verification, table accessors, and final exception-table emission support; unlike gcc/except.h, which primarily defines the EH region, landing-pad, catch, and status representations plus their public APIs.
